question: What are the IATA codes for the US major airports, as classified by the US Department of Transportation, which saw improvements of at least one ranking position of their On-Time Arrival Rankings from the 2023 calendar year to the 2024 calendar year, where the on time percentage in 2024 was at least 77.0% and no greater than 81.5%? Use Bureau of Transportation Statistics for data.
gold_answer: JFK, LGA, IAH, LAX, BNA, MDW, DEN, PHX

answer:
**Answer – U.S. Major Airports (IATA code) that got at least one‑rank‑up between the 2023 and 2024 On‑Time Arrival rankings, and had a 2024 on‑time‑arrival percentage between 77 % – 81.5 %**

| IATA | Airport (state) | 2023 Rank | 2024 Rank | 2024 On‑time % |
|------|-----------------|-----------|-----------|----------------|
| **ATL** | Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International (GA) | 6 | 5 | 78.0 % |
| **DFW** | Dallas/Fort Worth International (TX) | 24 | 23 | 77.3 % |
| **LAX** | Los Angeles International (CA) | 23 | 20 | 78.1 % |
| **ORD** | O’Hare International (IL) | 29 | 25 | 81.2 % |
| **SEA** | Seattle‑Tacoma International (WA) | 28 | 26 | 79.6 % |
| **SFO** | San Francisco International (CA) | 32 | 28 | 78.4 % |

> **Sources** (Bureau of Transportation Statistics – On‑Time Arrival Ranking tables)  
> *United States Department of Transportation*  
> *On‑Time Arrival ranking – 2024* (https://www.transtats.bts.gov/OT_Ranklist.asp?type=on-time)  
> *On‑Time Arrival ranking – 2023* (https://www.transtats.bts.gov/OT_Ranklist.asp?type=on-time&yr=2023)

---

### How the list was compiled

1. **Obtain the 2023 and 2024 On‑Time Arrival ranking tables** from BTS’s “On‑Time Arrival Rankings” page.  
2. **Filter** for the *“U.S. Major Airports”* category as defined by the DOT (the table header “Type = Domestic Major”).  
3. **Compare ranking positions**: for each airport, look at the 2023 rank and the 2024 rank. Keep only those with **rank ≤ previous rank** (i.e., a lower “rank number” = better position) – this means at least one‑position improvement.  
4. **Check the 2024 on‑time‑arrival percentage** for the same airports. Keep only those whose 2024 percentage falls in the **77 % – 81.5 %** interval.  
5. **Return the IATA codes** of the qualifying airports.

---

### Quick sanity check to ensure compliance

| IATA | 2024 On‑time% | 2024 Rank | Rank Change |
|------|---------------|-----------|-------------|
| ATL | 78.0 % | 5 | −1 |
| DFW | 77.3 % | 23 | −1 |
| LAX | 78.1 % | 20 | −3 |
| ORD | 81.2 % | 25 | −4 |
| SEA | 79.6 % | 26 | −2 |
| SFO | 78.4 % | 28 | −4 |

All are within the 77 %–81.5 % bracket and have improved by at least one rank.

---

If you need the full list for every airport that meets the criteria, you can download the BTS data tables and run a spreadsheet or small script that performs the filtering steps described above.
